study: Catch-up ratchet (time-decay leash): which setting captures the most profit while leaving room to run? Operator 2026-10-14 on BBWI: filled 18.39 10:41:25, peak 18.415, the leash overtook to last at 10:42:22 and sold 18.41 a minute in; the stop at last - $0.01 leaves no room for progress.
registered_at: 2026-10-14 ~11:20 ET, before any replay of these arms.
live_leash: ai_local_trail_time_decay_enabled true, decay_idle_sec 4 (a step after every 4 s without a new peak), decay_step_r 0.05R, decay_overtake true (when a step reaches last - cushion the stop jumps to last and the trade sells), cushion $0.01 (min_give_px 0). Static trail: give_r 0.12, peak_give_pct 0.35.
new_knob: ai_local_trail_decay_cushion_pct (default 0 = unchanged): the leash parks at least this % of price under last instead of $0.01. Code + test 2026-10-14; the live desk does not use it.

arms.ot_off: overtake off: park at last - $0.01 and wait for a dip into it
arms.nodecay: leash off (static trail, no-progress and the rest stay)

method: tools/replay_session.py on recorded sessions 2026-10-06..10-13 (6 days), whole live config of 94f2576 pinned, only the leash knobs vary; scripts/ratchet_sweep.sh after 16:15 ET and after the evening batch and the spread x RVOL sweep, <= 3 replays, deadline 03:30. Exits run every 2 s on the recorded prices (the replay's _live_exit is the desk's exit code).
costing: net bp = replay ret - full SIP quoted spread at entry, charged once (tools/studies/spread_rvol_score.py --arms ... --refs base).
metrics: per arm: opens/day, opens/10m, concurrency, win %, median hold, net bp/trade (t), VALUE = sum net bp per day (t), paired per-day value vs base.
pick_rule: Recommend an arm for a live paper A/B only if its paired per-day VALUE vs base is > 0 with t >= 2 and it is not worse than base on more than 1 of 6 days. Otherwise: no change; report the best point estimate as direction only.
prior: Skeptical of 'more room': exits-cannot-move-the-mean (42 shapes ~0 gross), holding-longer-loses-more (fills drift -9/-28/-43 bp at 5/15/30 min; every wider trail worse; the decay leash caps the fade). The 10/13 replay (one day): base -2.8, np_lob -3.5, np_lob_slow30 (30 s idle) -2.4, np_lob_step02 -3.4, leash off -3.4 net bp/trade: within ~1 bp. Expect win rate and hold time to move, not the mean.
replay_fidelity: Recall vs live 0.54-0.62; exit changes alter slot use and therefore later entries (stated, not corrected).
